Resize Image Online

Set width, height, or percent. Free, no sign-up, your file stays on your device.

  • Free, no sign-up
  • Processed on your device
  • No watermark

About this tool

Resize photos for social media, online forms, or email. Choose a percent, set a width or height, fit inside a given box, or use "exact size" to get precise dimensions such as 1080 × 1080 px. In "exact size" mode the edges are cropped so the picture does not get squashed.

How to use it

  1. Choose a file

    Drag a file into the box above or click to pick one from your device.

  2. Adjust the options

    Choose the format or quality, then press the process button.

  3. Download the result

    Save the files one by one or all at once in a ZIP.

Frequently asked questions

What is the difference between "fit in box" and "exact size"?
"Fit in box" keeps the whole image and the result can be smaller than the box. "Exact size" gives the exact dimensions by cropping the edges.
Will the image get blurry if enlarged?
Enlarging beyond the original size does not add detail, so the result may look soft or blurry.
Is my file uploaded to a server?
No. The conversion runs in your browser, so the file stays on your device. Only program components (such as the PDF library) are downloaded from this site; for HEIC and MP3 one extra component is also loaded from jsDelivr. Your file is not sent along.
What is the file size limit?
Ubahin allows 200 MB per file, but the real limit depends on your device memory. Very large files can make the browser slow or stop.
Is it free? Do I need to sign up?
Free, with no account. There is no watermark on the results.
